title: Signal: Installs no longer save exact versions
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges.
limitations: It matches a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
